title: EndHabitRequest
description: Irreversibly ends one active Habit only when the device-local today is strictly before end_date. Upcoming returns HABIT_NOT_STARTED; today=end_date returns HABIT_END_NOT_EARLY; completed/ended_early returns HABIT_ALREADY_ENDED. C++ derives ended_date, preserves end_date, and cancels future Habit Reminders atomically.
